title: Design Systems
definition: A Design System is a collection of reusable components, guided by clear standards (colors, typography, spacing), that can be assembled together to build any number of applications, ensuring visual consistency.
simpleExplanation: It's a Lego set created by your designers. Developers are only allowed to build the website using these specific Lego pieces, preventing rogue colors or weird button sizes.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Design Systems?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
